title: Implement fresh validation evidence and completion reconciliation

requirement.summary: Continue the reviewed development-governance plan by preventing a coding agent from claiming verified completion without evidence bound to the exact governed snapshot.

objective.rationale: Fresh validation and completion reconciliation close the development-time governance loop and create trustworthy inputs for the later Monitor.

goal: Bind declared validation commands to canonical task and Git snapshots, reconcile completion without false verified claims, and append privacy-bounded local governance events.
non_goals: Do not build the HTML Dashboard, GitHub export, background hooks, daemon, automatic remediation, merge, deployment, or release behavior.
Do not treat passing validation as proof that requirements or architecture are correct.
Do not persist source content, command text, validation output, credentials, or absolute user paths in evidence or events.
Do not implement the final automated installation and update UX in this slice.
acceptance_signals: Canonical snapshots cover committed-since-base, staged, unstaged, rename, and non-ignored untracked facts without storing source content.
Untracked .agentgov state and ignored build outputs do not invalidate evidence, while tracked changes and non-ignored validation artifacts do.
Both commit-before-validation and validate-before-commit workflows can verify when the validation-to-finish snapshot is unchanged.
Task, HEAD, index, worktree, rename, or non-ignored untracked mutations after validation prevent verified completion with actionable reasons.
Governance events are append-only, repository-local, privacy-bounded, and cannot grant Git or deployment authority.

items: An incomplete digest could allow stale or unrelated validation to appear fresh.
Tool-generated local state could invalidate its own evidence or leak sensitive material.
Executing a declared validation command crosses a deliberate local execution boundary and must never imply merge or deployment authority.

stop_conditions: Stop if snapshot calculation requires modifying the worktree, index, branch, or history.
Stop if evidence cannot exclude local AgentGov state without also hiding tracked repository changes.
Stop if persisted records require source content, raw command text, raw validation output, credentials, or absolute user paths.
Stop if an advisory requirement or architecture judgment would be needed to claim deterministic verification.

decision.rationale: The user explicitly directed development to continue after the reviewed Phase 2 core was completed. The delivered task was paused on 2026-08-05 to remove it from automatic discovery; this is routing hygiene, not a claim of semantic completion, acceptance, merge, or release.
